artifacts.summary: Baseline measurement and conversion plan for docstring/citation normalisation: all acceptance gates already green at HEAD (incl. the literal home/benjamin grep), 713 References entries classified (181 bibliographic vs 532 cross-references), 4-key bib merge with per-key direction measured through typst, and C20 tier 1 (582/1028 citations in the edit set) identified as the dominant gated regression risk with an exact per-file-delta repair recipe.

user_decision.question: Two bibkeys cited in FormalSystem/Metalogic/Expressiveness.lean:67,69 resolve to nothing in either bibliography: 'stavi1979' (the Stavi connectives, Dedekind-incomplete case) and 'gabbay1980' (the separation property). Should each get a new references.bib entry, or be re-pointed to an existing key (StaviConnectives.lean already cites gabbay1994 Ch.9 s.3 for the same content, and gabbayhodkinsonreynolds1994 Ch.10 is the tree's usual separation citation)?
user_decision.context: Affects two lines in one file. Not currently gated -- C15 reads only def|thm|lem|cor|app|rmk anchors, not bracket bibkeys -- so both have dangled undetected. Every other part of the sweep can proceed without this answer.
